none: PAS NLM-C8A37B: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Thick flan minim of House of Constantine, probably an irregular Fallen Horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Head right. Reverse description: probably soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman; the horse is most in evidence. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 6.9mm, Weight: 0.52gms, die axis: possibly 6
